pages.text: /* 增强阴影效果 */ :root { --shadow-light: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); --shadow-medium: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); --shadow-heavy: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } /* 卡片阴影增强 */ .l_main .post-wrapper, .l_side .widget, .article, .post-block, .timenode, .category-list a, .tagcloud a { box-shadow: var(--shadow-medium) !important; transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .l_main .post-wrapper:hover, .l_side .widget:hover, .article:hover, .post-block:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-heavy) !important; transform: translateY(-2px); } /* 侧边栏组件阴影 */ .l_side .widget { border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(45,45,45,0.95); } /* 导航栏阴影增强 */ #l_nav .navbar { box-shadow: var(--shadow-medium) !important; } /* 文章列表项阴影 */ .post-wrapper { border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(45,45,45,0.9) !important; } /* 时间线阴影 */ .timenode { background: rgba(45,45,45,0.9) !important; border-left: 3px solid #3dd9b6; } /* 按钮悬停效果 */ .btn, button { box-shadow: var(--shadow-light); transition: all 0.3s ease; } .btn:hover, button:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-medium); transform: translateY(-1px); } /* 封面阴影 */ #l_cover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-heavy); } /* 移动端底部导航阴影 */ #l_cap + div { box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } /* 代码块阴影 */ pre, .code-block { box-shadow: var(--shadow-light); } /* 搜索框阴影 */ .search-box { box-shadow: var(--shadow-light); } /* 滚动条美化 */ ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #1a1a1a; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #555; border-radius: 4px; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #777; } /* 友链卡片网格布局 */ .friends-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; padding: 20px 0; margin-top: 20px; } .friend-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 20px 15px; background: rgba(45,45,45,0.9); border-radius: 16px; text-decoration: none !important; transition: all 0.3s ease; box-shadow: var(--shadow-light); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .friend-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-heavy); border-color: rgba(61,217,182,0.3); } .friend-avatar { width: 70px; height: 70px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 12px; border: 3px solid rgba(61,217,182,0.5); transition: border-color 0.3s ease; } .friend-card:hover .friend-avatar { border-color: #3dd9b6; } .friend-avatar img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .friend-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 8px; text-align: center; } .friend-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .friend-tags .tag { font-size: 11px; color: #3dd9b6; background: rgba(61,217,182,0.15); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .friend-card:hover .friend-tags .tag { background: rgba(61,217,182,0.25); } .friend-desc { font-size: 12px; color: #888; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; } .friend-signature { font-size: 12px; color: #aaa; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } /* 响应式调整 */ @media (max-width: 768px) { .friends-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px, 1fr)); gap: 15px; } .friend-card { padding: 15px 10px; } .friend-avatar { width: 60px; height: 60px; } }

posts.text: Welcome to Hexo! This is your very first post. Check documentation for more info. If you get any problems when using Hexo, you can find the answer in troubleshooting or you can ask me on GitHub.
